sessionHeader: SYNTHETIC SESSION. Fictional client c01 (Ananya R.), session 2026-11-05. Not a real person.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: How did the release week go?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Bad, as expected. I was online till 2 most nights.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: That sounds exhausting. How are you feeling today?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Tired. And annoyed with myself for slipping back.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Slipping back during a release week is pretty expected. What happened with the update in the sync?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: I didn't do it. My manager took the update himself and I was relieved, which made me feel worse.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Relieved and then worse. Say more about the worse part.

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Like I'm hiding. Like I'll never get promoted if I can't talk in meetings.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: That's a heavy thought to carry into a meeting. What would you say to a friend who thought that?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: That one update doesn't decide a promotion.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Can you say that to yourself?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: I can try.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Let's put the update step back on the list for this week, smaller this time. What's a smaller version?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Maybe I post the update in the chat first, then say two lines out loud.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Two lines out loud. I like that. And sleep, now the release is done?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: I'll turn notifications off again from tonight.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Good. Keep the sleep log going too, so we can see if it comes back.

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: One more thing. You said earlier you didn't want your manager mentioned in messages from us. That still stands?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Yes, please. I don't want anything with his name on my phone.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Understood. Same time in two weeks?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Yes, the 19th.
